# Pinned Material Master sources

These source JSON/Java files are unchanged from Tinkers' Construct revision
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`:

https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/tree/f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2

The manifest records exact paths and SHA-256 hashes. The production advancement
adapts only the icon item key. The predicate bridge reads native `tic_materials`
instead of the source tool stack wrapper. ToolStackItemPredicate's modifiable
tag gate is retained in the sibling `modified_tool` source fixture.
